headline: Names the Post Office at 322 Main Street in Oakville, Connecticut, the "Oakville Veterans Memorial Post Office."
what_it_does: This law renames a specific U.S. Postal Service building in Oakville, Connecticut. The building at 322 Main Street will now carry the name "Oakville Veterans Memorial Post Office." It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
